definition: act belief polarity follows belief when polarity=false and reverses it when polarity=true. belief is one binary representation at each input; target is its independently supplied true value and successful response. Successful requires act=target at every input. Direct requires polarity=false everywhere. Polarity is a thin action-preference proxy; the Boolean rule supplies no complete account of desire, content or agency.
